qt: to the Commission Marcin Sypniewski (ESN) Subject:

Coking coal is listed in Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2024/1252 as a critical raw material, but not in Annex I, which covers strategic raw materials. In response to Question P002114/20231, the Commission outlined the general criteria and data sources. However, in Special Report 04/2026, the European Court of Auditors noted that the weighting of the criteria had not been specified and that the results of individual assessments had not been published. 1.

How does the Commission intend to respond to these findings made by the Court, and will it publish the methodology for comparing raw materials and the individual assessment results prior to the 2027 review?
Was coking coal assessed separately when the strategic list was drawn up? If so, what were the grounds for its exclusion; if not, why not?

Will the Commission, in the review due by 24 May 2027, take into account forecasts of the steel industry’s demand for coking coal, the actual pace of implementation of alternative steel production technologies, and the indirect importance of the raw material for strategic supply chains?
